organization_logic.macro_structure: Nineteen prose pages. Graph and indices (6 pages), two time scales (2), composite indicator and tests (7), advice (2), generalization (2).
organization_logic.dominant_pattern: Define, give the intuition, check against the scoreline.
organization_logic.section_coupling: The indicator consumes both the spectral indices and the stationary distribution. Advice consumes only the indicator.
organization_logic.argument_quality: Strong where a reading is tied to a scoreline or a p-value. Weaker where weights and bin edges are chosen silently.
human_organization_signals: curiosity opener instead of a gap statement
an assumption weakened in the sentence after it is made
a question put to the reader mid-analysis
a warning not to confuse two similarly named scores
a marginal p-value kept in the table
limitations that name the skipped papers
global_organization_chain: Known method to a new domain
Score to a test and to advice

main_argument_chains.claim: Four spectral indices describe how easily the ball crosses a side.
support_steps: aggregate passes to a symmetric matrix
take the largest eigenvalue and the algebraic connectivity
add clustering and mean shortest path
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Without the symmetry choice the Laplacian indices would be unavailable, and the structural half of the indicator would not exist.

main_argument_chains.claim: A trailing window and a seasonal chain capture the two time scales the full-match graph misses.
support_steps: recompute the four indices along the match
pool the season into a 30-state chain
read the stationary mass as possession share
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Without the split, short-term collapses and long-term habit would be averaged into one number.

main_argument_chains.claim: The composite indicator localizes the cause of a result and separates team quality from opponent effects.
support_steps: condition advice on coach and venue
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Without the component split, a draw could not be traced to formation rather than personnel.
